answer: defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with bonded, at-stake standing. For each disputed or high-value task, a random vertex in the trust graph is picked and a small quorum of long-standing, staked agents near that vertex is sampled to grade outcomes, their verdicts cross-checked like a lantern lighting only paths actually walked. Fresh identities are never sampled, so mass-registering fakes gains nothing. To matter, an attacker must age many identities through real costly work, stake bonds on all, and then collude consistently - like forcing a mirror
